name: How do I clean and maintain kitchen backsplash tile?

mainEntity.name: How do I clean and maintain kitchen backsplash tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backsplash tile is relatively simple to clean, but harsh cleaners should be avoided. For ceramic and porcelain, warm water mixed with mild dish soap or a neutral pH cleaner wiped down with a microfiber cloth removes daily grease splatters effectively. If your backsplash features natural stone or marble, stay away from acidic or abrasive cleaners such as vinegar, lemon juice, or bleach, as they etch stone surfaces and strip protective sealers. Reapplying stone sealer once every year or two preserves the finish against stubborn cooking oils.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean backsplashes with warm water and mild, neutral dish soap using a soft cloth; avoid vinegar or bleach on natural stone and reseal stone periodically.
